meta.name: frontend
meta.description: MUST USE for frontend/web UI/UX/visual work: building, styling, redesigning pages/components, React setup, performance audits, visual QA, taste, and polish. Routes four rulesets: design taste router and brand references; perfection for Playwright/Chromium Lighthouse/Core Web Vitals; ui-ux-db palettes/fonts/guidelines; designpowers personas/accessibility/critique/handoff; plus curl-only lazyweb real-app-screen research and the beui.dev interaction catalog. Triggers: frontend, UI, UX, design, redesign, styling, layout, animation, motion, interaction, micro-interaction, make it feel alive, premium, luxury, minimal, brutalist, Awwwards, DESIGN.md, mockup, React, Lighthouse, accessibility, WCAG, Core Web Vitals, looks generic, make it pretty, like X brand, lazyweb, design research.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让网页界面更美观、更流畅、更易用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常写前端页面/组件,却拿不准视觉细节与性能表现
copy.tagline_en: Make web interfaces more beautiful, smoother, and easier to use
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build frontend pages or components, unsure about visual polish and performance

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 处理前端任务时先归类再查专用设计参考;要求先写 DESIGN.md 设计规范;性能审计用真实浏览器;产出带完整设计系统而非一次性样式。
howto.when: 当话语涉及前端/界面/视觉工作(如 UI、UX、design 等),或要求重设计、性能审计、视觉打磨时触发。

say.text: 像 Stripe 一样设计这个页面,并先写 DESIGN.md
say.note: 会参考 Stripe 风格并生成 DESIGN.md

say.text: 给这个 React 应用跑一遍 Lighthouse 审计,要求全部满分
say.note: 会在真实浏览器审计并出报告

say.text: 这个按钮的悬停动效太生硬,帮我优化一下
say.note: 会调用交互参考来重做动效

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude classifies frontend tasks, consults the right design references, demands DESIGN.md before coding, audits in a real browser, and delivers a design system, not one-off styling.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the request involves frontend/UI/visual work (e.g. UI, UX, design), or asks for redesign, performance audit, or visual polish.

say_en.text: Design this page like Stripe, and write DESIGN.md first.
say_en.note: Will reference Stripe's style and produce DESIGN.md.

say_en.text: Run a Lighthouse audit on this React app and demand full scores.
say_en.note: Will audit in a real browser and output a report.

say_en.text: This button's hover animation feels stiff—please polish it.
say_en.note: Will use interaction references to redo the motion.
